data_source: Terry M. Therneau, survival 3.8-12 (CRAN); Rotterdam data as described by Royston and Altman (2013)
cohort_membership: both margins from the same 2982 publicly distributed Rotterdam patient records; membership verified during source derivation, not inferable from marginal files
risk_convention: n_risk counts exits >= t immediately before events at t; event precedence at ties
P_endpoint: recorded recurrence or observed death within recurrence follow-up; no later OS event used to extend prior recurrence censoring
D_endpoint: recorded death or censoring according to original OS follow-up
event_rows: strictly before tau; boundary events and post-horizon histories withheld
study_design: controlled marginal release from publicly distributed linked data, not a naturally unlinked clinical release
